The following events took place in '''38 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This year was known as '''Year 3''' before the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

==Events==
*A [[Unidentified retired Galactic Republic pilot|pilot]] retired from the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]], Chapter 2</ref>
*[[Mazie]] and [[Berri (Twi'lek)|Berri]] are captured in a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] raid on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Path to Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>
*[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], then known as Padmé Naberrie, joins the [[Apprentice Legislature/Legends|Apprentice Legislature]].<ref name="DBPA">{{DB|character|amidala|Amidala, Padmé}}</ref>
*A [[Star/Legends|star]] going supernova destroys [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]]. Efforts are made to relocate some of the [[Shadda-Bi-Boran (species)|inhabitants]], but they are unable to adapt to the habitats of other planets.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Tayvor Mandirly]] travels to [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]] to settle a dispute on the Colfillini plantations there, and is brutally murdered by [[Raxis]] and [[Nolid]]. His remains are discovered by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>
*[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] become slaves on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by getting sold by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
